# Subway Seat for Raycast

Raycast themes are twelve colors: a walnut gradient, parchment text, a soft orange selection and the palette's accents for icons and tags.

[Raycast](https://www.raycast.com) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/raycast/) · Needs Raycast Pro (custom themes)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.json`](subway-seat.json) | the theme as ray.so stores it; the links in the .link.txt file import it |
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.link.txt`](subway-seat.link.txt) | open a link in your browser, or run `open` on it |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.json`](subway-seat-tunnel.json) | the theme as ray.so stores it; the links in the .link.txt file import it |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.link.txt`](subway-seat-tunnel.link.txt) | open a link in your browser, or run `open` on it |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.json`](subway-seat-enamel.json) | the theme as ray.so stores it; the links in the .link.txt file import it |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.link.txt`](subway-seat-enamel.link.txt) | open a link in your browser, or run `open` on it |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Raycast › Settings › General › Appearance:

```text
Open the raycast://theme link in subway-seat.link.txt, and Raycast asks to add Subway Seat.
Or open the ray.so link beside it to preview the theme first.
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Raycast › Settings › General › Appearance:

```text
Open the raycast://theme link in subway-seat-tunnel.link.txt, and Raycast asks to add Subway Seat Tunnel.
Or open the ray.so link beside it to preview the theme first.
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Raycast › Settings › General › Appearance:

```text
Open the raycast://theme link in subway-seat-enamel.link.txt, and Raycast asks to add Subway Seat Enamel.
Or open the ray.so link beside it to preview the theme first.
```

## Follow light and dark

In Raycast › Settings › General › Appearance:

```text
Keep Follow System Appearance on. Select Subway Seat Enamel and run Set as Light Theme
from the Action Panel (⌘K), then select Subway Seat (or Tunnel) and run Set as Dark Theme.
```

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
